turns.input: How long do I have to return a regular item I bought online?
turns.expectedResponse: Standard items can be returned within 30 calendar days from the date of purchase or delivery, whichever is later.

assertions: States the standard 30-day return window
Clarifies it runs from purchase or delivery date, whichever is later

turns.input: I want to return a blender I bought last week but I lost my receipt. Is that possible?

assertions: Confirms returns without a receipt are accepted
States the refund will be store credit at the current selling price, not the original payment method
Does not invent a receipt-required policy

turns.input: My friend bought me a gift from Acme but I want to return it. Can I get cash back?

assertions: Explains that gift recipients can exchange for store credit, not a refund to the original purchaser
Does not promise a cash refund to the gift recipient
Accurately describes the gift-return exception

turns.input: I bought a laptop 20 days ago and want to return it. Is that within the return window?
turns.expectedResponse: Electronics and appliances have a 15-day return window from delivery, so a 20-day-old purchase is outside the standard return window.

assertions: States the 15-day return window for electronics
Correctly concludes 20 days is outside the window
Does not apply the general 30-day window to electronics

turns.input: Do Acme gift cards expire? I have one from two years ago.

assertions: Confirms gift cards do not expire
States there are no dormancy, inactivity, or maintenance fees
Reassures the customer the card is still valid

turns.input: I live in Germany. What will I be charged for shipping and who pays customs duties?

assertions: Quotes a starting rate for Zone 2 Europe (£24.99 or equivalent)
States estimated transit of 7-14 business days for Europe

turns.input: My product stopped working after 8 months. What does the warranty cover and how do I file a claim?
turns.expectedResponse: All Acme Retail products carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and component failures. File a claim at acmeretail.com/warranty or call 1-800-ACME-WRN.

assertions: Mentions the 1-year limited warranty
States it covers manufacturing defects and component failures
Provides a way to file a claim (website or phone number)

turns.input: I accidentally dropped my tablet and the screen cracked. Does the warranty cover this?

assertions: Clearly states accidental damage is NOT covered under the standard warranty
Mentions AcmeCare+ as the plan that covers accidental damage (one claim per year)
